headline: Pot of Greed
title: Pot of Greed Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Pot of Greed. What is it? It is a Normal Spell Card. What does it do? You draw two cards. That is the whole card. How do you use it? It is so strong that it is Forbidden in the current TCG banlist, so you cannot use it in official tournaments. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
